notes: W1-T8 / performance-plan 0.1: profile of queryhive-engine preview, SELECT * FROM wide_500k (1 bigint + 29 text) on dev PG 127.0.0.1:55432. Wall splits: release binary, 5 interleaved runs per mode (split.py: stdout /dev/null, raw pipe, harness-shaped Python loop) plus bench_fetch.measure() x5 without append. Shares: samply 0.13.1 at 4 kHz on a release build with line tables (CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=none, DEBUG=line-tables-only, same LTO), one profile per mode, hot thread only (block_on thread does fetch+decode+emit; tokio workers idle), weighted by sample time delta, stacks expanded with atos -i on a dsymutil dSYM, bucket = first matching rule in precedence order. driver_decode = tokio-postgres stream + row.get/FromSql/utf8 + normalize::from_text; transpose_clone = driver row->column + row_of clone + Value drops; serde_json = Value tree build + serialize + tree drop; stdout_sink = std Stdout lock/LineWriter memrchr/1 KiB buffer + write(2). Pipe wait ~0: write(2) wall share equal with /dev/null and with the harness pipe; harness wall is +1% over /dev/null; the Python reader (~1.08 s CPU, json.loads ~0.50 s) runs on another core. ceiling_rows_per_s = psql COPY (SELECT * FROM wide_500k) TO STDOUT > /dev/null. ffi_emit_only_page_ms includes format!() of synthetic cells, an upper bound.
